Travel Planning & Budget Management System ​

Nagpur | Pune | Jalgaon | Amravati | Pandhurna | Bhandara ​

 ​

​

  • Introduction :​

​

  • •Travel planning involves managing destination, accommodation, transportation, activities and expenses. ​

  • •​

  • •Using multiple platforms makes the planning process complex and time-consuming.​

​

  • •Managing the entire trip within a fixed budget can be challenging. ​

  • •​

  • •WanderPlan is a travel and budgeting application designed to provide organized trip planning in one platform. ​

  • •​

  • •It helps users plan trips based on their budget, preferences and requirements.​

Contents​

​

Sr. No.​

Paper Title and its Author​

Details of Publication​

Findings​

1​

Personalized Travel Package Recommendation — Qi Liu, Yong Ge, Zhongmou Li, Enhong Chen & Hui Xiong​

IEEE ICDM, 2011​

Uses tourist preferences, location and season to provide personalized travel-package recommendations.​

2​

Personalized Trip Recommendation for Tourists Based on User Interests, Points of Interest Visit Durations and Visit Recency — Kwan Hui Lim et al.​

Knowledge and Information Systems, 2018​

Recommends points of interest by considering user interests, visit duration and travel constraints​

3​

A Systematic Literature Review for the Tourist Trip Design Problem — José Ruiz-Meza & Jairo R. Montoya-Torres​

Operations Research Perspectives, 2022​

Reviews 102 studies on tourist trip design and identifies optimization approaches for itinerary planning.​

4​

An Integrated Recommender System for Multi-Day Tourist Itinerary — authors in Applied Soft Computing​

Applied Soft Computing, 2023​

Proposes an integrated system for creating personalized multi-day itineraries while considering tourist preferences and limitations.​

Literature Survey​

​

Sr. No.​

Paper Title and its Author​

Details of Publication​

Findings​

1​

Personalized Travel Itinerary Recommender System — Pranav Bookanakere, Nidhi P G, Disha M, Siddharth Soora, Uma D.​

ACM ICCRD 2026​

Optimizes budget, distance and number of places visited, while also providing personalized hotel recommendations and detailed itineraries.​

2​

A Novel Greedy Genetic Algorithm-Based Personalized Travel Recommendation System — Remigijus Paulavičius, Linas Stripinis, Simona Sutavičiūtė, Dmitrij Kočegarov & Ernestas Filatovas​

Expert Systems with Applications, 2023​

Develops personalized travel recommendations while considering itinerary-planning constraints.​

3​

Personalized Itinerary Recommendation: Deep and Collaborative Learning with Textual Information — Lei Chen, Lu Zhang, Shanshan Cao, Zhiang Wu & Jie Cao​

Expert Systems with Applications, 2020​

Uses user interests and textual information to generate personalized itineraries under time constraints​

4​

Recommendation Rules to Personalize Itineraries for Tourists in an Unfamiliar City — Ines Gasmi, Makram Soui, Khaoula Barhoumi, Mourad Abed​

Applied Soft Computing, 2024​

Uses multi-objective optimization to recommend POIs according to tourist interests and trip constraints.​

Literature Survey​

​

  • Problem Identified :​

  • •​

  • •Travel planning involves managing destination, accommodation, transportation, activities and expenses. ​

  • •Travelers often use multiple platforms for different requirements. ​

  • •It is difficult to estimate the total trip cost in advance. ​

  • •Unexpected expenses can cause the trip to exceed the planned budget. ​

  • •Creating a suitable itinerary within a fixed budget can be time-consuming.​

​

  • Justification​

​

  • •WanderPlan integrates trip planning and budget management into a single platform, helping users create a practical travel plan according to their budget and preferences.​

  • •​

Problem Statement​

​

  • Justifications for Selecting the Title​

​

  • • WanderPlan represents both travel (“Wander”) and organized planning (“Plan”). ​

  • •​

  • •Travel planning involves multiple factors such as budget, accommodation, activities and itinerary. ​

  • •​

  • •The project aims to bring these requirements into one platform. ​

  • •​

  • •It focuses on helping users plan trips according to their budget and preferences. ​

  • •​

  • •The title clearly reflects the project's main purpose: smart and organized travel planning. ​

  • •​

​

Justifications for Selecting the Title​

​

  • Objective of the Project : ​

​

​

  • • Develop an integrated travel and budget planning application.​

​

  • •Plan trips according to the user's budget and preferences. ​

​

  • •Generate itineraries for organized day-wise travel. ​

​

  • •Estimate and manage expenses to maintain budget control. ​

​

  • •Provide travel information such as destinations, accommodation and activities.​

​

Objectives of the Project​

​

  • •A single platform for complete travel planning.​

​

  • •Budget-based trip planning according to user preferences. ​

  • •​

  • •Day-wise itinerary for organized travel. ​

  • •​

  • •Estimated and managed trip expenses. ​

​

  • •Information about destinations, accommodation and activities. ​

  • •​

  • Expected Outcome: A smooth, organized and budget-friendly travel planning experience.​

  • Expected output of the project​
